subject: HackNW steward credits & 60-day trial extension request
messages:
From: Julia Romero <julia@hacknw.org>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Request: maintainer compute credits + 60-day trial extension for HackNW

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the quick intro call earlier — HackNW is ramping and we had a lot of interest from maintainers who would benefit from short-term access to model credits for mentor sessions and demo prep. Two asks from the organizer side:

- Can Redwood provide a one-time top-up of credits for 18 maintainers (listed in the attached CSV)? We were thinking a modest allotment per maintainer (approx. $200 worth of usage each) so they can run local demos during the weekend.
- Separately, a small number of workshop participants (organizers & mentors) would benefit from a 60-day trial extension beyond the standard 30-day window so they can finish post-event projects.

We know this is promotional but HackNW has a track record of high-quality maintainers and we typically highlight partners on our site. If helpful, we can include Redwood in the mentor sponsor tier and share metrics after the event.

Attached: hacknw-maintainers-list.csv, event-budget.xlsx

Can you confirm feasibility and any next steps?

Appreciate it —
Julia
Julia Romero
Head of Partnerships, HackNW
julia@hacknw.org
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
To: Julia Romero <julia@hacknw.org>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Request: maintainer compute credits + 60-day trial extension for HackNW

Julia —

Really appreciate the details and the CSV. Quick acknowledgement: both asks are reasonable and align with our community grants program, but I need a quick internal approval for the exact credit size and whether we can extend trial length to 60 days for mentor accounts.

Proposed next steps from my side:
- I’ll loop in Aditya (partnerships approvals) and Soojin (community ops) for budget sign-off today.
- If approved, we usually issue a one-off promo code per maintainer (expiring in 90 days) and a separate trial-extension token for workshop mentors.

Can you confirm a deadline when the credits must be live? The event is on Aug 14-15, correct?

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Developer Outreach, Redwood Inference

Kimberly / Soojin —

After reviewing the attendee list and the event reach, I’m comfortable approving a one-time top-up equal to $200 per maintainer (USD), capped at 18 maintainers (total not to exceed $3,600). Approve a 60-day trial extension for up to 6 mentor accounts.

Operational notes for fulfillment team (Marissa, please action):
- Create 18 unique promo codes labelled HACKNW-2026-MNT-XX, each redeemable for $200 worth of hosted credit. Expiry: 90 days from issuance.
- Create 6 trial-extension tokens HACKNW-2026-MENTOR-TX, add 60 extra trial days to eligible accounts.
- Mark the action with related link HS-98432 in HubSpot and attach the CSV.

Marissa — can you confirm timeline to issue codes? Ideally we issue them no later than Aug 7 so mentors can test before the event.

Thanks,
Aditya
